prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If object visible and within reach, approach and pick up. If not, scan and move or wait. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <Action ID = DoTaskWithObject    /> <Action ID = ScanArea    /> <Action ID = MoveToLocation    /> <Action ID = WaitForInput    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectWithinReach    /> <Condition ID = DoesObjectHaveProperty    /> <Condition ID = IsPathClear    /> <SubTree ID = RobotTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectVisible? THEN
			DO ApproachObject
	ELSE
			IF IsObjectWithinReach? THEN
			DO PickUpObject
	ELSE
			IF DoesObjectHaveProperty? THEN
			DO DoTaskWithObject
	END
